title.narrative: Additional number of SAVS stocked up to meet the food demand of beneficiaires during the period of food shortage

comment.narrative: for the AF

A SAVS stocked up to meet the food demand of beneficiaries is defined as stocked up at 85% of its capacity. The period of foodshortage is defined as 4 months in 2012 (June to September is identified as the regular period of food shortage). Average stock wasinitially thought to be 12MT per village, but went down to 6.73 MT in order to increase the number of beneficiary villages of theinitial wheat stock distribution.

Regional Development Committees decided to increase the initial number of SAVS from 600 to more than a 1,000 by decreasing theaverage amount of cereals per SAVS. This decision was taken to maximize the number of beneficiaries in consideration of the varyvast area affected by the drought. After restructuring, an additional 375 SAVS is planned to benefit from additional wheat stock.
